question: Will the Strait of Hormuz reopen this month, yes or no?

lines.text: A tanker in the Strait of Hormuz reported an explosion sixteen nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman, UKMTO says.
The blast hit its port side waterline. UKMTO says all crew are safe and accounted for.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two more oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines.
lines.note: IRGC statement, via MEE and DW

lines.text: They say the tankers used an unauthorised route with navigation systems off.
That claim came through Iranian state media, DW reports.
On Thursday, Iranian media said five tankers and a tug caught fire.
UKMTO says October saw more than thirty five incidents, the most since the war began.
At least five ships have been attacked so far in November.
Iran also says it downed a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island. The US has not confirmed it.
The Guards say there will be no change until the seven conditions are met.

scene.quote: there will be no change until the seven conditions are met

lines.text: Day two hundred and fifty three tomorrow. Will Hormuz reopen this month, yes or no?
